component.name: Telamon Gates
component.summary: Chat with an AI model that runs on your own computer

description.p: Telamon Gates is the AI chat of Telamon OS. Ask a question and the reply streams in as it is written, with formatted text, tables and code you can copy in one click.

Conversations are kept as plain files on your computer, grouped by day in the sidebar and easy to search. Pick a model, set a system prompt, and watch how much of your graphics card's memory is in use.
First release: conversations with streaming replies, a sidebar grouped by day, tokens per second and a VRAM meter.
